rationale: Setup binds at ss/100C max-RC on reg-to-reg paths; hold (+0.09 ns, no buffers), slew/cap (0 vs 295) and DRC stay clean, so T_eff at 8.59 ns is natural delay. Round 3's blabla-style combination set the record (6.81 ns). In that mode delay rises with utilisation: blabla util 27 gave 6.62 ns reg-to-reg, R3-5 util 39 6.81, R3-6 util 48/density 72 (more congestion, 514 first-pass DRCs) 7.13. TPE's util/density picks are unpredictable, so pin util 28, density 50%. TPE already strongly favours routability, ABC buffering and sizing, so those pins are freed; keep AREA 3, orfs, slew 40, timing-driven placement off, and post-GRT timing repair for the re-run ratchet, where repair becomes active.
